game.name: Nba 2k10 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: NBA 2K10 is a basketball game for Xbox 360. The title features simulation-based gameplay for more real-world games. In the My Player mode, you guide your avatar from the depths of the basketball world to the top of the NBA. In addition, each player has his own specific animations and movements.
